title: 215-16 Northern Boulevard: which dimensions are printed, recorded or GIS, and what the 2017 survey settles

question.text: Which dimensions of lot 70 come from printed tax-map labels, administrative records and GIS, and what must the named 2017 survey settle?
question.property: 215-16 Northern Boulevard, Queens (borough 4, block 7334, lot 70; BBL 4073340070)

evidence.authority: NYC Department of Finance (Digital Tax Map library)
evidence.title: Tax map of block 7334, effective 2017-03-22
evidence.excerpt: lot 70 labelled 100.76 ft on Northern Boulevard and 100 ft deep; lot 1 labelled 99.25 by 100 ft (the owner research's reading of page 1; the orchestrator re-fetched this map on 2026-10-10 and found it byte-identical) (official file not kept in the repository; its SHA-256 b734d49b88df8de0d13ba0c79bff3ac5032752af4ec6050385f6694187a01e24 is listed in docs/research/owner-research/2026-10-10-215-16-northern-evidence/source-manifest.json)

evidence.authority: NYC Department of Finance (Digital Tax Map library)
evidence.title: Tax map of block 7334, effective 2021-07-29 (flagged current)
evidence.excerpt: the same 100.76 by 100 ft labels for lot 70 and 99.25 by 100 ft for lot 1; an ALLEY label across the southern part of the northern lots (owner research's reading; map re-fetched byte-identical 2026-10-10) (official file not kept in the repository; its SHA-256 cefd083d936cbd0a4e41e6763ed19e554a5726706c19bd5c0606695b9a6fce0c is listed in docs/research/owner-research/2026-10-10-215-16-northern-evidence/source-manifest.json)

evidence.title: PLUTO rows for block 7334

evidence.title: Tax-map change history, block 7334, transaction 76338
evidence.excerpt: Lot Apportionment; Auth_for_Change: "Recorded deeds CRFN# 2005000015416, 01/07/2005  Survey by Christopher M. Buckley, 2/21/2017"

evidence.authority: NYC Department of Buildings (NYC Open Data: DOB Job Application Filings)
evidence.title: DOB BIS job 440655961 (builders pavement plan)
evidence.excerpt: job_description "BPP FOR 200.76' TOTAL FRONTAGE - CORNER LOT, FRONTAGE ON 215 PLACE:100', FRONTAGE ON NORTHERN BLVD:100.76' - FILED IN CONJUNCTION WITH NB #121329641. NO CHANGE IN USE, EGRESS, OR OCCUPANCY."

evidence.authority: NYC Department of City Planning (Zoning Resolution portal)
evidence.title: ZR 12-10 definition: lot area
evidence.excerpt: "Lot area" is the area of a #zoning lot#.

provisions_read: the owner's measurement rule of 2026-10-06: an outline's area is a drawing measure, never used in a zoning calculation (docs/measurement-basis/)
exceptions_considered: Printed tax-map dimensions and graphic coordinates are different kinds of evidence; neither is a survey.
100.76 x 100 = 10,076, not 10,075: the descriptors are not an exact rectangle.
meaning_and_applicability.reading: No deed or survey area has been read. The printed tax maps, PLUTO and the DOB pavement-plan text agree on a 100.76 ft frontage; the GIS outline is wider. The program uses PLUTO's recorded area for zoning figures with its basis named, and keeps the GIS outline for drawing only.

measurement_basis.double_count_risk: Mixing bases: a GIS-derived footprint (about 10,310 sq ft) applied to a recorded-area lot.

observed_facts: Tax maps 2017 and 2021: lot 70 labelled 100.76 by 100 ft.
PLUTO 26v2: lot 70 area 10075 sq ft, frontage 100.7600000, depth 100.0000000.
MapPLUTO 26v2 outline: 10387.99 sq ft; north edge 103.87921 ft.
DOF transaction 76338 (2017-03-22): "Recorded deeds CRFN# 2005000015416, 01/07/2005  Survey by Christopher M. Buckley, 2/21/2017".
conflicts: Area 10075 sq ft (recorded) against 10387.99 sq ft (GIS): 312.99 sq ft, about 3.11%.
Frontage 100.76 ft (printed, PLUTO, DOB text) against 103.87921 ft (GIS).
Apportionment date 2017-03-22 (tax-map history) against PLUTO appdate 2017-04-07.
conditions: Zoning figures use the recorded area 10,075 sq ft with its basis named; the footprint by portion stays withheld (questionnaire A1, choice 1 meanwhile).
settled_by: the Christopher M. Buckley survey of 2017-02-21 named in DOF transaction 76338
the 2018 deed 2018013000919001 with its Schedule A

searches.next_step: ask the owner for the survey or authority to request it (questionnaire F1)
owner saves it in a browser (questionnaire F1)
the certified street-line record in settled_by

worked_example.inputs: Recorded area 10075 sq ft; GIS outline 10387.99 sq ft.
worked_example.expected: Zoning figures are worked on 10,075 sq ft and say so; the GIS area never enters a zoning calculation; the footprint by portion stays withheld until a survey or deed settles the area.
worked_example.basis: The owner's measurement rule of 2026-10-06 and questionnaire A1's meanwhile line.
worked_example.prepared_by: orchestrator (Claude Code session 01TpXJN7), 2026-10-11; worked from the law text, not from a program run; not professionally checked

regression_cases: A GIS outline area never enters a zoning calculation (measurement-basis tests).
Area is never derived as frontage x depth (100.76 x 100 = 10,076, not 10,075).
dependency_assessment: Every lot whose recorded area and GIS outline disagree has the same two bases; the program already keeps them apart (measurement in EPSG:2263 via mappluto_geometry_arcgis.py; display only via mappluto_lot_outline.py). No change; the survey would settle this lot only.

findings: G1 at 1b41c813: conflicting_evidence honest; conflicts real (10,075 against 10,387.99 sq ft; 100.76 against 103.88 ft; 2017-03-22 against 2017-04-07); recorded area for zoning, GIS for display, consistent with the code.

freshness.limitation: The tax maps and MapPLUTO outline were re-fetched by the orchestrator on 2026-10-10 (identical); no survey or deed was read.
